parse.title: Atharva-Veda Samhita/Book I/Hymn 1
parse.text:
1. The thrice seven that go about, bearing all forms—let the lord of speech assign to me today their powers, [their] selves (tanú).

Ppp. reads paryanti in a, and tanvam adhyādadhātu me for d. MS. combines trisaptās in a.

2. Come again, lord of speech, together with divine mind.

SPP. with the majority of his authorities reads punar ehí. Sayana glosses vasos pate as the lord of wealth.
